semiconductor_relevance: High — KESCO provides advanced AI-based metrology and image analysis solutions specifically tailored for nanoscale inspection in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Keisoku Engineering System (KESCO) specializes in engineering AI solutions that integrate nanoscale imaging data with manufacturing data to enhance design and production decisions. Their platforms, such as Pollen Smart3, focus on real-time measurement and defect detection, enabling significant yield improvements in semiconductor processes.
capabilities: AI-based metrology and image analysis platform for nanoscale inspection
Machine learning platform for uncertainty quantification
Real-time measurement of nanoscale images from various microscopy techniques
technical_expertise: AI and machine learning for image analysis

regional_presence.France: KESCO is headquartered in Grenoble, France, indicating a strategic presence in the European semiconductor market.
